claim: proposal-receipt.md §3 row 1.6, server half (founder /goal 2026-11-07). A HEIF or AVIF ftyp brand at bytes 4-11, or bytes in no supported format, makes extract() throw PaperFormatRefusal before the key guard, with no model call and whatever the declared mime. route() catches it and returns unreadable() before applyCurrencyRules, so the paper is stored with currency ''.
verify: grep -qF 'head.toString("latin1", 4, 8) !== "ftyp"' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.service.ts && grep -qF 'if (iso) return { unreadable: unreadablePhotoFormat(iso) };' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.service.ts && grep -qF 'return { unreadable: UNREADABLE_FILE_FORMAT };' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.service.ts && grep -qF 'if ("unreadable" in format) throw new PaperFormatRefusal(format.unreadable);' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.service.ts && grep -qF 'if (err instanceof PaperFormatRefusal)' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-intake.service.ts && grep -qF 'stores a HEIC photo unread with its reason and never calls the model' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.spec.ts && grep -qF 'keeps currency empty and carries the HEIC sentence as its only warning' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-intake.service.spec.ts
